objective: Compare geographic error distributions, coverage and compute cost on the same archived recordings.
original: Use published algo07v5 fast no-repair, selective gap, one omitted track and two omitted tracks. Both c=0 and fitted-c are outputs of the same worker on the same observation, candidate policy, other priors and search budget. Use original DS26 repeat zero for per-recording results and validate both repeats against the published 127-case summaries.
ds26: Replay the frozen blind-study engine on every member of the original 159-recording DS26 campaign, retaining unavailable inputs. Report all attempts, the original 127 recordings successful for every v5 role and both repeats, and the previously selected eight-case DS26 subset. DS26 participated in earlier method development. This comparison is retrospective.
ds26_offers: Run the receiver with v5's original 25 km square alone, and with that same square plus distractor squares 45, 65 and 250 km from its center. Rotate the three offsets together by a deterministic hash of the recording ID, and scramble offer order without scoring. These reruns test the supplied prior separately from the four-region operating mode.
ds29: Use the eight DS29 acquisitions chosen in the prior blind study. Validate their original native-input digests and per-capture truth. Reuse locked four-tile predictions, including true-missing conditions. Also rerun the prototype with the original v5 tile alone. Run the same original four-role v5 worker with DS29's frozen input specification, original priors, native numerical backend, both arms and 1200 s per-worker deadline; retain every outcome. The eight recording lanes share the loaded x86 host, one CPU and one numerical thread per v5 worker. New bulk scientific work uses existing data only and is bounded to 45 minutes.
external: Report the locked present/missing distributions on StarLoc, synthetic and Altrincham without changing v5's published region contract or constructing replacement native detector factors from derived tracks.
metrics: Use mean-Earth-radius great-circle distance in km for both estimators. One recording contributes once per configuration, arm and condition. Report conditional P50, P90, P95, maximum and fraction within thresholds against all attempts. Withheld, unavailable, failed and timed-out trials have no numeric distance. Use paired differences only on common recording IDs. Coordinates from a forced grid choice are diagnostic. Compute worker/solve timings and RF-residual effects separately.
